descriptor: Product designer in Gothenburg making calm tools

voice.summary: A first-person, easy voice with the confidence of someone who explains their work well. It prefers plain verbs and small honest claims, in the spirit of the calm products it designs.
dos: Write in first person and keep it conversational
Describe outcomes for health, finance and learning tools in plain words
Keep project blurbs to one clear sentence
donts: Buzzwords such as ninja, rockstar or disruptive
Long case-study jargon in tile copy
Self-congratulation with no example behind it

taglines: Calm, useful products for real people
Health, money and learning, made gentle
boilerplate: Noor Eliasson is a product designer based in Gothenburg who works with small teams on health, finance and learning tools, favouring calm interfaces over clever ones.
